_notes: Starter for the Opel Blitz 3-ton (4x2, open bed), read off the sheet Opel Blitz 3-ton.png by eye: trace every part over it in the Lab. Ground vehicle (truck), side view only. Metres: d = back from the front of the truck, h = up from the ground (the tyres' bottom). Stations are [d, top h, bottom h, half width]. fuselage = the cab with its bonnet, bed = the cargo bed (stakes = the posts' d), tarp = the canvas over its bows (also the shape of a closed box body), wheels = circles at the axles' z (any number: a six-wheeler has three axles), axles = z (tyre centre out from the centre line) and half (half a tyre's width). cab: boxes [d0, h0, d1, h1] for the side window, the door's outline and the bonnet's louvres. cover = open | tarp | closed (the Lab's preview setting and the truck's default; passengers are drawn only when open). points: passenger dots (the head of a seated man; the infantry session reads them) and one exit (tailgate or rear door). Calibrate: the ground under the front of the truck, then the ground under the rear end (6.02 m). scale = model units per metre (5 = the planes' 0.1 m pixel).
